tools.name: search_calculators
tools.description: Find MonsiTools calculators by keyword (for example 'runway', 'break even', 'roas', 'loan payment'). Returns each match's slug, name, category and input names. Use describe_calculator for details, then calculate to run one.

tools.name: describe_calculator
tools.description: Returns a calculator's name, category, formula, input names and page URL, given its slug.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Runs a MonsiTools calculator on the given inputs and returns the result. Needs a MonsiTools Premium API key, sent as 'Authorization: Bearer mt_live_...' when connecting.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "calculate" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
